  "title": "Native memory learning and bounded outcome capture",
  "body": "# Native memory learning and bounded outcome capture

**Status:** accepted

## Context
The earlier [[decisions/native-codex-memory-consolidation]] qualified local embeddings and native Codex consolidation but kept scheduled learning disabled. The September 21, 2026 source review and native qualification now support activating the existing upstream maintenance path.

## Decision
Retain ai-memory 2.3.2 as the shared agent-lab/agent-lab memory of record, with the existing local 384-dimensional MiniLM embeddings, native Codex gpt-5.6-luna provider and medium effort. Preserve repository-allowlisted capture and disabled historical backfill. Enable the upstream hourly learning scheduler with one eligible session per project per tick and a ten-minute age minimum. The scheduler includes every database project; this deployment currently has one adopted scope.

Enable sanitized assistant Stop excerpts in native Claude, native Codex and the Desktop WSL hook profile. Both server and client opt-ins are configured. Native Codex trust was applied through the normal hooks interface. Claude's pre-existing prompt-capture opt-out remains unchanged. Excerpts are capped at 2,000 bytes; oversized final messages above 64 KiB are dropped.

Use daily rule-based lint and hourly local embedding backfill. Scheduled page/observation forgetting is disabled; upstream hollow-project cleanup still runs. Retain session-end consolidation.

## Consequences
Actual Codex and Claude answers were captured and independently read back; native consolidation completed. Two accelerated scheduler ticks each skipped an ineligible historical session without a model call. A separate manual review rejected insufficient durable evidence and applied no proposal. This establishes working capture and maintenance paths, not improved future answer quality or measured token savings. Final hourly cadence is configured; a later hourly tick, physical reboot and hot reload of an already-running Desktop task remain unproved. Learning claims are once per native session, including admission skips.

Basic Memory, Graphiti, Mem0, Hindsight, Claude-mem, Letta/Letta Code and Supermemory remain workload-specific alternatives, not additional automatic capture stores. The portable selection, source pins, commands and returned evidence are in https://github.com/seathatflowsinourveins/native-agent-stack/blob/main/docs/memory-landscape-maintenance.md.
